question: Cariappa, Kargil, Katari, Manekshaw and subrto are five different sadans in sanik school. Kargil is to the right of Subrto and Katari is the left of Cariappa and right of Kargil. Subrto is to the right of Manekshaw. Which sadan is in the middle?
solution:
Carippa, Kargil, Katari, Manekshaw and subrto are five sadans in sanik school.

1) Kargil is to the right of Subrto and Katari is the left of Cariappa and right of Kargil.

2) Subrto is to the right of Manekshaw,

The arrangement are given below- 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fdc67b0b063271c14af1bf8e1643e838543e80644b66ae97ee8e7c79215a896.png] 

Kargil sadan is in the middle.

Hence, **"Kargil"** is the correct answer.
